name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: No GDACS orange or red cyclone alerts on 13 Nov; Pena and Cempaka rated green with tracks ended
state: GDACS listed no orange or red tropical cyclone alerts on 13 Nov. Its two recent entries, Tropical Cyclone Pena and Tropical Cyclone Cempaka, were both rated green, with tracks ending on 11–12 Nov (GDACS). No typhoon or cyclone threatening land within 72 hours was flagged.
for_you: No major Pacific or Indian Ocean cyclone threatens land. Travellers to cyclone-prone regions can check FCDO travel advice and local meteorological services.
why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
